scoring_justification: Junction length, jog direction, and critical breaking angle are outputs of an MD simulation that cannot be rerun inside the verifier; the b² criterion can be recomputed from the reported Burgers‑vector fractions. Agent‑reported values are compared to paper‑reported gold with generous tolerances. The b² fractions are verified by exact string comparison.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text (junction length ~10 r0, Fig. 2; jog direction [0-1-1] from Section 2.2.3; critical breaking angle 70° from Section 2.2.4; b² sums from Eqs. (3)-(8)).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are taken verbatim from the original publication

outputs.description: Contains the determined junction formation (boolean), junction length in units of r0, jog direction as crystallographic string, critical breaking angle in degrees, and a nested object with b² analysis for the two partial reactions.

output_contract.notes: Only the repulsive intersection case is required. The hidden checker compares the reported values against reference values from the paper within tolerances.
